question: Which German chemist used the technique of preparing hydrocarbons by electrolysis of solutions of salts of fatty acids?
solution: The correct answer is __**Hermann Kolbe.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Hermann Kolbe:-** • He is a German chemist who used the technique of preparing hydrocarbons by electrolysis of solutions of salts of fatty acids. He discovered this method in 1845.
